items.title: Your Guide to AWS Cloud Resilience Sessions at re:Invent 2026
items.summary: Resilience is foundational to keeping what you build on AWS running. It matters to your customers, your stakeholders, and to your business; and re:Invent 2026 has a Cloud Resilience session to help you strengthen your approach. This year’s lineup spans breakout sessions, chalk talks, code talks, workshops, and lightning talks and we’ve organized them below […]
items.creator: Nate Richards
